concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 2 – Regime‑Switching VAR Estimation (table entry for FR‑006)
concerns.text: The plan states that it will “extract lag‑1 autocorrelations” for BTC and ETH from the RS‑VAR (SC‑004). In a VAR(1) model the diagonal entries of the coefficient matrix are AR coefficients, not the marginal autocorrelation of each series. Autocorrelation depends on the full coefficient matrix and the error covariance. Reporting the AR coefficient as the “lag‑1 autocorrelation” is therefore a mis‑specification that could mislead the validation of regime‑dependent serial correlation.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 0 – Data Acquisition & Validation and Phase 2 – Regime‑Switching VAR Estimation
concerns.text: The plan never includes a diagnostic test for stationarity of the log‑return series (or of each regime‑specific subset) before fitting VAR models. VAR inference assumes (weak) stationarity; without confirming this assumption the estimated coefficients and subsequent hypothesis tests (SC‑004, SC‑005, SC‑003) may be invalid. A standard Augmented Dickey‑Fuller or KPSS test per regime should be added, with a fallback to differencing or regime‑redefinition if non‑stationarity is detected.
